name: recorded_workflow
description: Navigates to GitHub Docs, switches to the Enterprise Cloud version, searches for SAML SSO authentication, and follows a result link to the GitHub Privacy Statement.

steps.instruction: Click the Documentation link in the navigation menu.
Click the version picker to open documentation version options.
Select the Enterprise Cloud documentation version.
Click the search field to open the search and Copilot interface.
Click the first AI-suggested search result for SAML SSO authentication.
Click the GitHub Privacy Statement link.
